summary.zh-CN: 过拟合是模型在训练数据上表现很好，却没有学到能迁移到新样本的稳定规律。它可能记住了[[term:training-set|训练集]]的偶然细节、噪声或偏差，因此[[term:validation-set|验证集]]、[[term:test-set|测试集]]或真实数据上的表现明显变差。
summary.en-US: Overfitting occurs when a model performs well on training data but fails to learn stable patterns that transfer to new examples. It may memorize accidental details, noise, or bias in the [[term:training-set|training set]], so performance on the [[term:validation-set|validation set]], [[term:test-set|test set]], or real data becomes much worse.

coreConclusion.zh-CN: 训练集越来越好而训练集之外的数据开始变差，说明模型正在记忆训练细节，而不是继续提升泛化能力。
coreConclusion.en-US: When training performance keeps improving while data outside the training set gets worse, the model is memorizing training details instead of improving generalization.
